status: Requires expert review before production use
globalPrinciples: A decision is conditional on product group and screening purpose; never treat a PMID as having one universal decision.
Apply the existing official CER screening criteria before expert-derived patterns.
Use same-product examples as the primary retrieval pool.
Treat Duplicated and Already held as administrative statuses, not clinical relevance labels.
Do not exclude a review solely because it is a review; determine whether the purpose is clinical evidence or SOTA/comparator evidence.
For combined treatments, determine whether outcomes are independently attributable to the evaluated device.
Gemini must produce a new decision and conclusion after comparison; it must not copy one example mechanically.
